name: Graphic displays
purpose: The gpf table lists the Graphic Displays (GRDs), the SCOS-2000 telemetry plots, one record per graphical display. Each record gives the screen layout (full, half, quarter or sliced screen, with at most 8 plots), the header line, whether the plot scrolls when it reaches the end of the plot area, whether a hardcopy is produced automatically at the end of the plot area, the time span of the X axis (days, hours, minutes; for parameter-against-parameter plots this sets the display duration), the colour of axes, ticks and grids, and the number of tick and grid intervals on each axis. The parameters plotted and their scaling are defined in gpc. The ICD remarks that gpf and gpc are not imported into the SCOS-2000 database but are read directly by SCOS-2000 applications, and from R5.0 display definitions are converted into XML files in the FARC. The update-rate field exists only for external applications and is not used by SCOS-2000.

fields.name: GPF_NUMBE
fields.description: Name of the Graphical Display (GRD): alphanumeric string that uniquely identifies it; referenced by gpc.GPC_NUMBE.

fields.name: GPF_TYPE
fields.description: Screen layout of the graphic display. The number of plots per screen portion is a maximum, currently 8 in total. The type also determines the allowed plot-area codes in GPC_WHERE.

values.meaning: Full screen: up to 8 plots against time or against another parameter

fields.name: GPF_HEAD
fields.description: Alphanumeric header shown on the top line of the display.

fields.name: GPF_SCROL
fields.description: Controls whether the display scrolls when the plot reaches the end of the plot area(s). It has no meaning for parameters plotted against spin phase or against another parameter.

fields.name: GPF_HCOPY
fields.description: Controls the automatic hardcopy (print) when the end of the plot area is reached.

fields.name: GPF_DAYS
fields.description: Number of days in the X-axis time span; for parameter-against-parameter displays it sets the duration of the display. Integer 0 to 99.

fields.name: GPF_HOURS
fields.description: Number of hours in the X-axis time span (or display duration for parameter-against-parameter plots). Integer 0 to 23.

fields.name: GPF_MINUT
fields.description: Number of minutes in the X-axis time span (or display duration for parameter-against-parameter plots). Integer 0 to 59.

fields.name: GPF_AXCLR
fields.description: Colour of the axes, ticks and grids.

fields.name: GPF_XTICK
fields.description: Number of intervals between ticks on the X axis. Integer 1 to 99.

fields.name: GPF_YTICK
fields.description: Number of intervals between ticks on the Y axis. Integer 1 to 99.

fields.name: GPF_XGRID
fields.description: Number of intervals between grid lines on the X axis. Integer 1 to 99.

fields.name: GPF_YGRID
fields.description: Number of intervals between grid lines on the Y axis. Integer 1 to 99.

fields.name: GPF_UPUN
fields.description: Display update rate in seconds, integer 1 to 99. Provided for external applications that read the database; not used by SCOS-2000.

relationships.note: One GRD has many gpc records (one per plotted parameter).
The display type determines the valid plot-area identifiers in gpc.

history: ICD 5.1 §3.3.2.6.3 (icd-5-1-tos-gci, PDF p.52-53) has the same 14 fields, but GPF_MINUT is a fractional number 0.0-59.9 (0.1 meaning a 6-second X axis when days and hours are 0) and GPF_UPUN is an update rate in milliseconds with no range. ICD 6.7 DCR S2K-DCR-5502 made GPF_MINUT an integer 0-59 and asked to clarify the unit and size of GPF_UPUN/SPF_UPUN (ICD 7.0 Annex 1, PDF p.258-259; the annex misspells the field as 'GFP_UPUN'). ICD 6.7 Draft A (icd-6-7-drafta PDF p.107-109), ICD 6.9 (icd-6-9-archive-org PDF p.111-113) and ICD 7.0 (PDF p.114-116) all print the integer GPF_MINUT and UPUN in seconds, range 1-99. Since SCOS-2000 R5.0 (ICD issue 6.4) display definitions are no longer kept in the run-time (POST) MIB database: the ASCII tables are converted on request into XML files stored in the FARC, in a delta fashion that keeps previously imported displays and displays created at run time with the TM Desktop editor (ICD 7.0 §2.5, PDF p.24; §3.3.2.7, PDF p.110; Annex 1, PDF p.254). The XML format is in [AD-5], SCOS-2000 TM Displays and Printout definitions Service ICD (ICD-5001), which is not in the library. Not modelled in pyscos2000 (7.2).
notes: gpf.dat is present but empty (0 bytes) in the 2025-09-16 and 2020-04-16 Solar Orbiter releases and in the SWA IDB, so the database holds only a placeholder column COL1 and no rows. pyscos2000 has no gpf model. ICD 7.0 lists GPF_DAYS/HOURS/MINUT, axis colour and the tick/grid counts as mandatory even though most display tools could supply defaults. The HPSDB note (h-p-1-asp-tn-1060-mib-processing-hpsdb, PDF p.29) forbids real values in GPF_MINUT (range 00-59), ignores GPF_UPUN, and lists the header as 'DPF_HEAD' (a copy error).
